scenes.heading: Why Rich People Get Richer
scenes.say: Why do rich people keep getting richer? The answer is one simple idea called compound interest. Let me draw it out for you.

scenes.heading: Simple Interest
scenes.say: First, simple interest. You invest one thousand dollars at ten percent. You earn one hundred dollars every year, no matter what. After thirty years, you have four thousand dollars.

scenes.heading: Compound Interest
scenes.say: Now, compound interest. This time, your interest also earns interest. Year one, eleven hundred. Year two, twelve hundred and ten. After thirty years, you have over seventeen thousand dollars.

scenes.heading: It Works Like a Snowball
scenes.say: It works like a snowball rolling down a hill. It starts small and slow, but the bigger it gets, the faster it grows.

scenes.heading: Time Is the Secret Ingredient
points: Start early, even with a little
Let the years do the work
scenes.say: The secret ingredient is time. Start early, even with a small amount. Don't touch the money. And let the years do the heavy lifting.

scenes.heading: It Can Work Against You Too
points: At 25%, debt doubles in about 3 years
scenes.say: But be careful. Compounding works against you too. Credit card debt at twenty five percent doubles in about three years. So pay it off first.

scenes.heading: Subscribe for More Money Lessons!
scenes.say: If this helped, hit subscribe and like for more simple money lessons, drawn out on the whiteboard.
